live_validation.scope: Temporary driver uses production request builders, provider loop, protocol decoders, Library client and HTTPS transport. Session route selection and lifecycle are covered by deterministic tests.
limitations: Claude was checked live through OpenRouter; native Anthropic wire handling was tested deterministically.

OpenRouter GPT runs and streamed Claude Chat runs returned correct Library facts and web version but did not establish hosted web use. Passing OpenRouter combination evidence uses Claude with Responses streaming and Chat Completions buffered.
No provider model fallback was added. Answering models were selected explicitly for each acceptance check.
Streamed Chat Completions citation retention was checked deterministically after the live runs.
